scenarios.title: Deploy Safe wallet for new user
scenarios.expectedAction: Call relayer deploy, wait for proxy address, confirm deployment

scenarios.title: Approve USDC.e spending for CTF contract gaslessly
scenarios.event: User needs to approve token spending without paying gas
scenarios.expectedAction: Encode approve call, submit via relayer, confirm STATE_CONFIRMED

scenarios.title: Execute batch approve + transfer atomically
scenarios.event: User needs multiple operations in single transaction
scenarios.expectedAction: Package both ops, execute via relayer batch, confirm all succeed

scenarios.title: Builder credentials are invalid
scenarios.expectedAction: Report authentication failure, suggest checking builder credentials

scenarios.title: Transaction reaches STATE_FAILED
scenarios.expectedAction: Report failure with reason, do not retry automatically

criteria: Builder HMAC authentication works: Does the skill correctly sign requests with builder credentials?
Safe wallet deployment succeeds: Does the skill deploy and return the proxy address?
Transactions reach confirmed state: Does the skill track tx through STATE_NEW to STATE_CONFIRMED?
Batch operations are atomic: Does the skill execute multiple ops in single relayer call?
No POL gas required: Does the skill operate without native token balance?
